mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, active_scope_key, requested_at, cooling_ends_at, revoked_at, finalized_at FROM auth_parent_account_cancellation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, user_id, status, active_scope_key, requested_at, cooling_ends_at, revoked_at, finalized_at FROM auth_parent_account_cancellation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_parent_account_cancellation SET status = 'REVOKED', active_scope_key = #{closedScopeKey}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COOLING_OFF' AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, active_scope_key, requested_at, cooling_ends_at, next_finalize_at, finalization_attempts FROM auth_parent_account_cancellation WHERE id = #{cancellationId} AND status = 'COOLING_OFF' AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_parent_account_cancellation SET finalization_attempts = finalization_attempts + 1, next_finalize_at = #{nextFinalizeAt}, last_finalize_error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{cancellationId} AND status = 'COOLING_OFF' AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE auth_parent_account_cancellation SET status = 'FINALIZED', active_scope_key = #{closedScopeKey}, finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, finalization_attempts = finalization_attempts + 1, next_finalize_at = NULL, last_finalize_error_code = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{cancellationId} AND status = 'COOLING_OFF' AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM auth_parent_account_cancellation WHERE status = 'COOLING_OFF' AND active_scope_key = 'ACTIVE' AND cooling_ends_at <= #{now} AND (next_finalize_at IS NULL OR next_finalize_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_finalize_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
